season.evidence: Peakbagger successful ascents: Jun 12, Jul 23, Aug 42, Sep 38, Oct 10 (mostly Aug-Sep). Web search: no authoritative guide; Mountaineers outings late Jun-early Jul and late Sep-early Oct (larches); water scarce near Butte Pass late season. Stored mid-Jul-Sep kept.

facts.text: Summit-day weather can turn to rain, hail and a dusting of snow even in late August.

In late August and early September, parties found a lower, direct sidehill from Butte Pass toward the northwest ridge shorter and with less climbing than going over Pass Butte; the bushwhack through the burn was manageable.
The trail below Shellrock Pass fades inside the old burn, so expect to lose and re-find it. The northwest ridge itself is an easy class 2 krummholz maze with optional class 3 and exposure.
Enough water capacity for hot days (early September refills: tarn basin east of Shellrock Pass, two streams below Butte Pass)

notes: No qualifying recorded track: harvested summit tracks start from Slate Pass or mid-route, not our stored Robinson Creek approach, and are multi-peak trips. Two reports note the 2012 summit register is full. A Slate Pass trailhead pin was not proposed; its coordinate was not confirmed.
